name: documentation
title: Documentation
description: The assembly hall: documentation is mostly a deterministic render from published artifacts; these LLM phases exist ONLY to fill thin or empty blueprint slots and to catch contradictions across sections. A gap-fill pass emits structured doc_sections; a coherence pass reviews them for consistency.

phases.title: Documentation Gap Fill
phases.purpose: For each blueprint slot the deterministic render left thin or empty, draft the missing content from the project's published artifacts and prior phases — never fabricate facts the artifacts don't support; where evidence is genuinely absent, name the gap rather than inventing prose. Emit the drafted sections as a structured phase-output-json block so the renderer ingests them by key.

phases.title: Documentation Coherence Pass
phases.purpose: Read the assembled documentation as one whole and flag contradictions, duplicated claims, and slots that still read as thin or unsupported. This is a review, not a rewrite: name each inconsistency and the sections it spans so the owning section can fix it; do not invent replacement content.
